personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK with 7 Dark-First Utility Data Hierarchy
personality_one_liner: A deeply premium, cinematic, and data-rich dark mode ERP that frames business operations with luxury and precision.

spacing.rule: Maintain generous layout paddings. Do not cramp elements. Keep touch targets at least 44pt.

do's: Use blur on the bottom floating pill tab bar.
Use frosted glass on sticky header backgrounds.
Apply translucent layers over deep backgrounds for elevated elements like VIP upsells.
dont's: Never blur body text or dense data rows.
Do not use glass effects on basic input fields.
Avoid stacking multiple glass surfaces on top of each other.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure authentication gate with phone/SMS and password options.

states.loading: Centered sleek brand spinner over frosted background.
states.error: Bottom sheet toast with red error text.

screens.layout: Hero area with the large Navy logo (#021041) sitting over a subtle abstract background. Minimalist inputs for Phone and Password with thin borders that light up in `brandPrimary` (Gold) on focus. A segmented control or tab selector to switch between 'Password' and 'SMS OTP'. The primary CTA is a pill-shaped gold button sitting just above the safe area.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: High-level KPI overview for business owners and managers.

states.loading: Skeleton grids for the KPI cards.
states.error: Error banner prompting a data refresh.

screens.layout: Top portion uses `headerDeep` strip fading into the dark surface. A 2-col grid displays core KPIs (Revenue, Debts, Collections) utilizing `surfaceSecondary` cards with `pro` (gold) or `accent` (emerald) tinted icons. An interactive, smooth line chart sits underneath the KPI blocks for cashflow visualization.

screens.name: Products

states.empty: Illustration of an empty box with a prompt to 'Add first product'.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header with a search bar and horizontal scrolling filter chips (`brandTertiary` background when selected). A vertical list of products using high-contrast `surfaceSecondary` cards. Each card includes an image thumbnail (with gradient scrim if needed) and a stock status badge.

screens.name: Customers & Debts
screens.layout: Searchable list with initials avatars or client logos. Outstanding debts are distinctly highlighted in `error` or `warning` text. Each list item has a quick action to log a collection.

screens.name: New Sale (Invoice)

states.empty: Prompt to 'Select a product to start invoice'.

screens.layout: Large 'Add Product' button. A clean summary section docked above the tab bar showing total amounts, tax, and a big 'Confirm Sale' CTA. Uses absolute bottom sheet patterns for product picking to stay in-context.

screens.name: Subscription/Pro Upsell
screens.layout: A cinematic, immersive screen using a dark abstract luxury background. Centered VIP imagery/iconography with gold `pro` accents. A checklist of premium features, followed by a wide, glowing gold CTA button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the 'Dark Premium' default requested by the user. Ensure the UI feels like a high-end luxury app (deep charcoal backgrounds, subtle gold/champagne accents, and glassmorphism) rather than a generic SaaS.
The App is an Arabic RTL app. Ensure that text alignments default to right, chevrons point left, and `I18nManager.forceRTL(true)` is respected across all row layouts.
Implement the navigation bar as a 'floating pill'. It should hover slightly above the safe area bottom inset and utilize `expo-blur` to achieve a frosted glass effect.
The existing Navy logo (#021041) stays. In the dark theme, make sure it is placed in environments where it is visible, perhaps by introducing a subtle glow or utilizing the `headerDeep` strip.
Follow the specific color token dictionary precisely; the exact keys have been explicitly provided as constraints.
In the Login Screen, provide a toggle mechanism between SMS code and Password inputs without creating visual clutter.
Limit fonts to 'Cairo' globally, with weights capped at 500 max. Do NOT use bold variants.
